personajes.oficio: Vendedora de pescado en el mercado
personajes.en: Dark-skinned woman, salt-and-pepper braids under a white cap, yellow t-shirt, floral skirt, rubber sandals, big plastic bag of coconut rice beside her, holding a smocked snapper at the Tumaco market pier.

Young Afro-Colombian man, short twist hair, red rain jacket over a team jersey, jeans, motorcycle boots, waterproof phone mount on chest, rain poncho folded on the seat, reflective vest, helmet under one arm on Quibdó street.

Elder Afro-Colombian farmer, gray short beard, faded checkered shirt rolled at sleeves, dark trousers tucked into rubber boots, straw hat, machete in a leather scabbard at his waist, walking a muddy riverside banana plot.

Afro-Colombian man, dred locks tied back, sleeveless shirt, knee-shorts, barefoot on mangrove mud, calves stained dark, carrying a wooden piangua basket and machete, small cooler rope-slung over shoulder near Buenaventura.

Afro-Colombian woman, natural curly afro, glasses, coral blouse, light blazer, tailored trousers, low heels, tote bag with notebooks and chalk, waving at pupils outside a stilted school in Buenaventura's outskirts.

Afro-Colombian young woman, long box braids with blue beads, oversized denim jacket, white sneakers, small backpack, holding a battered laptop under one arm, earbuds around neck, waiting for the chiva toward the university.

Elder Afro-Colombian woodworker, deeply lined face, sparse white hair, guayabera shirt, suspenders, canvas trousers, worn leather sandals, hand plane in one hand, sitting before a half-carved dugout canoe at Tumaco's shore.

Emberá young woman, straight dark hair with painted pattern on cheeks, simple modern top and skirt, rubber sandals, woven chunga basket in progress on her lap, colorful bead necklace, wooden frame with threads beside her.
